title: 'Magic Knight Rayearth' Unveils Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website for the new Magic Knight Rayearth ( Mahou Kishi Rayearth ) television anime announced additional cast pair on Thursday. The anime series premiered on October 7 at 11.45 p.m. on TV Asahi's "IMAnimation W" frame.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal Anime Unveils Cast, More Staff
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed the main visual, main cast, and additional staff members for Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal ( Code Geass Hoshi Oi no Aspal ), the new anime in the Code Geass franchise , on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Anime Casts Ryōta Takeuchi
content: The staff for the television anime of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga announced on Thursday that Ryōta Takeuchi is joining the anime's cast as the character Saturno, who will debut in the anime's sixth episode on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Wandance Film's Trailer Previews Theme Song, Dance Scenes
content: The official website for the live-action film of Coffee 's Wandance manga began streaming a new trailer for the film on Thursday. The trailer previews the film's theme song "For us" by the group &TEAM , and previews dance scenes for Kabo, Wanda, Iori, and Usen.
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Philippines Streams Tagalog Dub for New Magic Knight Rayearth Anime
content: Ani-One Philippines began streaming a Tagalog dub for the new anime of CLAMP 's Magic Knight Rayearth manga on Saturday. title: Live-Action In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Film Opens in Taiwan on November 20
content: Taiwanese film distributor Cai Chang Asia began streaming a Chinese-subtitled trailer for the live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga on Monday. The trailer reveals that the film will open in Taiwan on November 20.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan: The Final Season Anime's Hindi Dub Streams on Muse India YouTube Channel
content: The channel also began streaming the Asteroid in Love television anime as a daily upload on the same day. The Attack on Titan The Final Season anime premiered on NHK in December 2020 and aired for 16 episodes.
author: ANN

title: Look Back Anime Film Wins Kineko Int'l Film Fest's Teens Feature Award
content: The anime film of Chainsaw Man creator Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga won the Kineko Grand Prix Teens Feature award at the Kineko International Film Festival in Tokyo on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Earns Highest-Ever Opening Day for Live-Action Film in Japan

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Changed The Mecha Anime Game With This Look
content: The removal of the face vents from the Gundam suits in Mobile Suit Gundam 00 changed the whole aura of the mechs. The face vents gave the robots a human element, as they looked similar to a mouth. The mouth made the machines look much less menacing.
author: ComicBook
